title: 游戏运行卡顿与帧率下降
description: 游戏在多种场景下出现卡顿、掉帧、冻结、延迟尖峰等性能问题，影响流畅体验。
evidence: If they clean up the bugs and performance without adding anything else to the game, it would be worth the current cost...
incredibly unoptimized, lags hard in certain areas despite having a 3060 which should be more than capable of running this
when a character is looking for parts to fix a component with it lags for each part

evidence_items.quote: the game visibly stutters when trying to find a path to an order even under the best circumstances
evidence_items.description: 即使在最佳情况下，游戏在尝试为命令寻找路径时也会明显卡顿
evidence_items.quote_zh: 即使在最好的情况下，游戏在尝试为一条命令寻找路径时也会明显卡顿

evidence_items.quote: 게임이 자주 끊기거나, 배속을 하나라도 올리면 조금 더 심해지는 문제가 있습니다
evidence_items.description: 游戏经常卡顿，提高倍速后更严重
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏经常卡顿，或者只要把倍速调高哪怕一档，问题就会更严重一些

evidence_items.quote: waiting for stutterings
evidence_items.description: 游戏出现卡顿
evidence_items.quote_zh: 等着卡顿

evidence_items.quote: there is the occasional bug / insufficient optimisation
evidence_items.description: 偶尔出现bug和优化不足。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 偶尔会有bug/优化不足

evidence_items.quote: 玩久了每次存读档都要一大堆现实时间
evidence_items.description: 玩久了每次存读档都要大量现实时间
evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩久了每次存读档都要一大堆现实时间

evidence_items.quote: 飞船大了之后，被别的飞船打，或者核反应堆爆炸，或者什么大规模爆炸，你就等着自己卡成PPT吧
evidence_items.description: 飞船变大后遭遇攻击或大规模爆炸时严重卡顿
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞船大了之后，被别的飞船打，或者核反应堆爆炸，或者什么大规模爆炸，你就等着自己卡成PPT吧

evidence_items.quote: the game is slow
evidence_items.description: 游戏运行缓慢
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏很慢

evidence_items.quote: put that into 16x speed, autotask and there goes the fps into the single digits
evidence_items.description: 多任务时帧率降至个位数
evidence_items.quote_zh: 把它调到16倍速度、自动任务，然后帧率就掉到个位数了

evidence_items.quote: 而且npc导致的卡顿问题依旧没有解决
evidence_items.description: NPC导致的卡顿问题仍未解决
evidence_items.quote_zh: 而且npc导致的卡顿问题依旧没有解决

evidence_items.quote: Large ships lag a lot. Large amounts of NPCs lag a lot. The older the save, the more laggy it becomes.
evidence_items.description: 大型船只和大量NPC导致严重卡顿，存档越老越卡
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大型飞船会严重卡顿。大量NPC会严重卡顿。存档越旧，卡顿就越严重。

evidence_items.quote: the game can't function on 16x speed once you get established
evidence_items.description: 游戏在16倍速下无法正常运行
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一旦你站稳脚跟，游戏就无法在16倍速下正常运行

evidence_items.quote: constantly fluctuating between 15-60 fps
evidence_items.description: 帧率在15-60fps之间波动，即使在高配置电脑上也是如此。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不断在15-60帧之间波动

evidence_items.quote: It constantly stalls between 5-30 seconds, often invoking Windows to tell me it's not responding
evidence_items.description: 游戏频繁卡顿5-30秒，有时导致Windows提示无响应。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它会不断卡顿5到30秒，还经常让Windows告诉我它没有响应

evidence_items.quote: он всё пытался выйти наружу воспользоваться кофейным автоматом, делая по тысяче просчётов маршрута в секунду, и из-за этого у меня ФПС падал до 1-10 кадров в секунду
evidence_items.description: AI路径计算导致FPS降至1-10帧
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他一直试图出去用咖啡机，每秒进行上千次路线计算，因此我的帧数掉到了每秒1-10帧

evidence_items.quote: фризы и падения ФПС вы испытаете в любом случае
evidence_items.description: 卡顿和掉帧，与硬件无关
evidence_items.quote_zh: 卡顿和帧数下降你无论如何都会遇到

evidence_items.quote: Really long loading times
evidence_items.description: 加载时间非常长
evidence_items.quote_zh: 加载时间非常长

evidence_items.quote: Fix the god-awful lag/stuttering/freezing issues
evidence_items.description: 严重的延迟、卡顿和冻结问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 修复那糟糕透顶的延迟/卡顿/冻结问题

evidence_items.quote: I've also had occasional stuttering that sucks but is still playable - it seems to happen after a while playing, and goes away after quitting and reloading

evidence_items.quote_zh: 我偶尔也会遇到卡顿，虽然很烦但还能玩——似乎是在玩了一段时间后出现，退出并重新加载后就消失了

evidence_items.quote: The massive performance hiccups that are so regular it suggests a complete lack of hardware sympathy.
evidence_items.description: 频繁且严重的性能卡顿
evidence_items.quote_zh: 巨大的性能卡顿如此规律，表明完全缺乏对硬件的体谅。

evidence_items.quote_zh: 卡顿

evidence_items.quote_zh: 不完全对性能友好，你会发现卡顿，不过开发者也在积极修复这些问题。

evidence_items.quote: too laggy as well

evidence_items.quote_zh: 而且还太卡了
